headline: Trump admin to loan up to ~1/3 of 1-million-barrel US emergency heating-oil reserve as diesel tops $6.50/gal amid Iran/Ukraine
dek: The Trump administration is offering to loan up to nearly a third of the 1-million-barrel US Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve (sites in New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Maine) via competitive bidding to fuel retailers and terminal holders, to tame prices that 'have surged on diesel…
sources: Reuters exclusive (Timothy Gardner); US Department of Energy statement; Energy Secretary Chris Wright on-record
fault_line: Real relief for winter heating bills — or a symbolic loan from a 1-million-barrel cupboard against a $6.50/gal crisis?
